title: UPLAND Taylor CNY 10,999 mechanical build
notes: The exact current Chinese manufacturer page matches the retained CNY 10,999 Taylor observation. It claims approximately 8.5 kg bare without pedals or computer mount and specifies Shimano 105 R7120 mechanical 2x12, a T1100+T800 carbon aero frame and fork, a T47 bottom bracket and fitted MAXXIS Pursuer 700x28C tires. It does not publish a maximum tire clearance.
